content.text: Please ensure Javascript is enabled for purposes of website accessibilitySkip to main contentCloseDownload the AppGet your news faster with our mobile experienceInstallNow44°Thu68°Fri66°SearchSearchUser IconSign In or Create AccountWatchfacebook icontwitter iconACCESSIBILITYIowa women’s basketball coach Jan Jensen has been named a semifinalist for the 2026 Wernerby IOWA'S NEWS NOW STAFFThu, March 19, 2026 at 11:32 AMIowa women’s basketball coach Jan Jensen has been named a semifinalist for the 2026 WernerComment on this story0CommentShare storySharetopics: Jan JensenIowaWomen’s basketballNaismith AwardWerner LadderNCAA TournamentBig TenCarver-Hawkeye ArenaRight arrowIowa City, Iowa — Iowa women’s basketball coach Jan Jensen has been named a semifinalist for the 2026 Werner Ladder Naismith Women’s College Coach of the Year award, the Atlanta Tipoff Club announced Thursday.In her second season, Jensen has led the Hawkeyes to a 26-6 record and a No. 2 seed in the NCAA Tournament. Iowa recorded seven wins over AP Top 25 teams, including five against top-15 opponents, tying program records.The Kimballton, Iowa, native has guided the Hawkeyes to 24 regular-season wins and 15 Big Ten victories, both among the best marks in recent program history.
